decisions.reason: The client explicitly changes only Big Block parameters; the Small Block prize amount, pool, and draw condition remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and draw trigger does not change the manual prize-claim method.
The source does not change the automatic $5 commission for code-based referrals.
Big Block remains active and still uses tickets, so the requirement to expose both Small Block and Big Block ticket counters remains valid unchanged.
The source changes the Big Block payout parameters and trigger but does not state that secondary royalties cease funding prize pools or begin generating referral tickets.
The Big Block parameter adjustment does not concern achievement badges or their award triggers.
The word block refers to the Big Block prize mechanism, not geographic access blocking.
Changing a prize value and draw trigger does not alter the requirement that public APIs, including pool-value endpoints, remain unauthenticated.
The client decision changes product parameters and does not change the required deployment network.
The Big Block prize adjustment does not change primary NFT mint behavior.
The dashboard requirement only establishes the categories of reward data displayed; the source does not change those categories or specify a dashboard presentation change.
The Big Block parameter adjustment does not change email authentication or access to dashboard reward areas.
